question: Kalsubai peak is located in which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kalsubai Peak, the highest point of the **Sahyadri Mountains,** is situated in the **Ahmednagar** district of **Maharashtra**, India.
 
• Standing at an impressive height of 5,400 feet (1,646 meters), it is often referred to as the **'Everest of Maharashtra'**.
 
• The mountain range is part of the Western Ghats, a **UNESCO** **World Heritage site **renowned for its biodiversity.
